issues.reason: An object-incorporating agent-nominalization fused from the surface is routed by the agent-nominalization bullet, whose worked example emits exactly the capability plus kind-relation the parse gives ((Inheritance egg_layer (can lay)), (Lay egg_layer egg)) and no head genus, and Core patterns defers to that section verbatim ('always emitted, exactly as Compound decomposition specifies'), so the Compound-kind clause's 'always emitted either way' — whose 'either way' governs the MODIFIER-genus branch — is not a rule this parse violates.

gaps_confirmed: Sentence-initial hyphenated capitalized plural label ('Harbor-lantern Keepers'): the Name-only capitalized-plural rule is stated only for a definite label ('the Wrens'), sentence-initial capitalization is uninformative about name-hood, and nothing says how a Capitalized-hyphen-lowercase run delimits the capitalized run.
new_gaps: Two Compound-concepts bullets both match a fused modifier+agent-nominalization symbol (harbor_lantern_keeper, egg_layer, dam_builder) and prescribe different atom sets: Compound kind says the head genus (Inheritance <compound> <head-noun>) is always emitted, while the agent-nominalization bullet's worked example emits only the capability and kind-relation. Which governs is unstated, so two faithful parses can differ by one atom.
notes: Every emitted atom is true of the sentence and well-typed: the bare-plural verbal generic becomes a rule at 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase companion (no quantifier word present), Agent for 'live' matches the prompt's own Oslo example, Near is the preposition actually used rather than a coined synonym head, and the definite 'the harbor' gets its witness plus type atom.
